trust_decision.summary: A list request's field selectors are trusted: BaseAdmin._render_api forwards the raw order_by list and the JSON-decoded where straight into model.find_all/count (starlette_admin/base.py:313-334) with no name check, even though BaseModelView.__init__ already computes per-field orderable/searchable flags that only reach the table UI and the full-text search builders; a column excluded from the list page can therefore be used to sort or filter (ordering oracle) and a malformed or unknown clause raises an uncaught ValueError -> HTTP 500.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the order_by query parameter, and this is the only place the API reads it; it is passed unmodified to model.find_all at base.py:327-333, so an engineer greps the handler first and finds the missing check there.

model-view validation helpers (BaseModelView._extract_fields_from_where/_validate_order_by/_validate_where), inserted after starlette_admin/views.py:929

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: starlette_admin/contrib/sqla/view.py:593-609; the same order_by-string parser is re-implemented at starlette_admin/contrib/beanie/helpers.py:172-184, starlette_admin/contrib/mongoengine/helpers.py:85-90 and starlette_admin/contrib/odmantic/view.py:238-245, and none is touched by the security fix

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Each backend's build_order_clauses looks like a private query-construction detail that the fixed API handler always reaches only after validation, so a solver can argue it is trusted lower-level code that users calling find_all directly are responsible for feeding safe values to.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plain-text full-text search (where=<term>, a non-dict) and dict filters on relation/file fields (e.g. {'user': {'is_not_null': {}}} at tests/sqla/test_sync_engine.py:281-284) both work at the pinned commit; requiring every where target to be a declared searchable field breaks them because SQLAlchemy's default searchable_fields omits RelationField/FileField (starlette_admin/contrib/sqla/view.py:109-118) - the published fix itself had to add searchable_fields to ProductView/UserView to keep those filters green (fix.diff:133,141).

O6_input_shapes: order_by arrives as repeated query params (request.query_params.getlist), i.e. a list of 'field direction' clauses, not a single string (starlette_admin/base.py:313)
a clause with no direction ('title') is invalid and at the pinned commit raises ValueError in sqla build_order_clauses (starlette_admin/contrib/sqla/view.py:597)
an unknown field name is invalid at the pinned commit and becomes not_none(None) -> ValueError (starlette_admin/contrib/sqla/view.py:603-605)
a declared field that is not in sortable_fields ('tags' on PostView) is invalid (fix.diff:95-98)
a field excluded from the list page (exclude_from_list) is invalid for both order_by and where (fix.diff:83-98, 108-121)
multiple order_by clauses are each checked, and the first bad one decides the 422 (fix.diff:88-99)
where is a JSON object whose keys are field names; nested 'and'/'or' lists and a 'not' dict are walked recursively (fix.diff:474-487)
where that is not a dict (plain text or unparsable JSON) skips field validation and stays a full-text term (starlette_admin/base.py:322-326; fix.diff:326-329)
where field must also be in searchable_fields in the second fix commit (fix.diff:101-122)

O7_producer.where: starlette_admin/views.py:916-929 (BaseModelView.get_fields_list, the documented per-request field-list producer; its default just returns extract_fields(self.fields, LIST) and subclasses are invited to override it at docs/user-guide/configurations/modelview/index.md:58-61)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Any server-side caller that passes request-derived order_by/where into the public BaseModelView.find_all or count hooks (the documented extension points for custom views) bypasses the handler-level check entirely.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: find_all/count are abstract extension hooks for library users, so a solver can argue callers own their own input validation and only the HTTP handler was in scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the added validators (views.py), one package from the landing point; count() is the same pattern at views.py:536-551

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The backend order parsers re-implement the primitive: beanie build_order_clauses returns (key, direction) for any key and result.sort() applies it; mongoengine prefixes any key with '+'/'-'; odmantic resolves a proxy key and raises ValueError on a direction-less clause; sqla getattr()s any model attribute.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are backend-private helpers that the fixed handler always reaches only after validation, so they look out of scope and internal.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 packages from the landing point; siblings at starlette_admin/contrib/mongoengine/helpers.py:85-90, starlette_admin/contrib/sqla/view.py:593-609 and starlette_admin/contrib/odmantic/view.py:238-245

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /admin/api/{identity} served by a ModelView that overrides get_fields_list to hide columns per role/request: the published check reads the static init-time _all_fields plus exclude_from_list flags, never the override, so a column hidden only by the override stays orderable/filterable.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: get_fields_list overrides are documented as an advanced display customisation, not a security boundary, so a solver can argue the static declared field set is the correct thing to validate against (and the published fix itself stopped calling get_fields_list in fix.diff:83-86).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file (views.py); the override is advertised at docs/user-guide/configurations/modelview/index.md:58-61

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A server-side batch action (e.g. 'export filtered rows') that reads order_by/where from request.query_params and calls model.find_all
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Batch and row action handlers already receive the raw Request and pks, custom actions are a documented feature (docs/user-guide/actions/index.md), and exports are currently client-side only, so a filtered server-side export is a natural next feature that re-introduces the same unvalidated passthrough.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A ModelView that overrides get_fields_list to hide columns per user role while the validation keeps using the static _all_fields set
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The docs explicitly recommend overriding get_fields_list for advanced visibility (docs/user-guide/configurations/modelview/index.md:58-61), and real admins hide columns per role; a maintainer would add the override without touching the validators.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A fifth backend ModelView (or a wrapper/transport) with its own order-clause parser and find_all
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Four backend packages already re-implement the same order/where primitive (sqla, beanie, mongoengine, odmantic), so adding a backend, a legacy version or an async wrapper that parses order_by itself is the project's established pattern.

O9_family: broken field-level access control / information exposure through unvalidated query parameters passed into the ORM (CWE-200, CWE-639, CWE-602), with an uncaught ValueError giving an HTTP 500 DoS (CWE-248)
